name: The True Masters
summary: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon asks you to speak with him after Lady Katrana Prestor. His watchful attention marks the next step in your dealings with Stormwind's court.

sections.title: Before Bolvar
sections.body: You have spoken with Lady Katrana Prestor, and now Highlord Bolvar Fordragon watches you closely. Speak with him to continue your dealings with Stormwind's court.

faq.answer: You speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.
You spoke with Lady Katrana Prestor before approaching Highlord Bolvar Fordragon.
Highlord Bolvar Fordragon watches you intently.
